subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Find animals from descriptions of their body parts.
Describe animals with It has … / It doesn't have …

tf.s: A camel has a hump on its back.
A bird uses its beak to eat.
tf.why: Yes, a beak is a bird's hard mouth.

tf.s: A seal has flippers and long whiskers.
tf.why: Yes, that is the seal in the quiz.

tf.s: A fish uses its horns to swim.
A hedgehog has spines on its back.
An oryx has two long horns on its head.

tf.why: Birds have feathers; snakes and fish have scales.

tf.s: A cat has flippers on its feet.
tf.why: Cats have paws; seals have flippers.

tf.s: Insects use their antennae to walk.
tf.why: They walk with their legs; antennae are on their head.

tf.s: Bees are important because they help plants grow.

boxes.q: What does a camel have on its back?
Which body part helps a fish swim?
A cat has long ___ on its face.
What does an oryx have on its head?
Which body part is sharp, on the end of a cat's toes?
What do seals use to swim?
Which body part does a snake use to taste and smell?

mcq.q: Write the body part: the hard pointed mouth of a bird.
Write the body part: the feet of a cat or a bear.
Which animal in the quiz has flippers and long whiskers?
Why are bees important, according to the quiz?
It has scales and a long tongue. It isn't a snake. What could it be?
mcq.why: Lizards have scales and long tongues.

o: It has spines on its back. It has small paws.
It has a hump. It has fins.
It has flippers. It has horns.
It has a beak. It has scales.
mcq.why: Hedgehogs have spines and small paws.

mcq.q: Which animal is the odd one out: snake, fish, bird?
o: bird – it has feathers, not scales
mcq.why: Snakes and fish have scales; birds don't.

mcq.q: Which animal is the odd one out: oryx, goat, seal?
o: seal – it has flippers, not horns

mcq.q: An animal has a hump and lives in the desert. Which body part helps you know it is a camel?
mcq.why: Of these animals, only camels have a hump.
